responsibility: Defines the check_consts module’s shared const-checking context and public entry points. It owns `ConstCx`, exposes module structure, and provides helper queries that classify the current body’s const context, function signature, permitted unstable const features, and whether recursive const-stability enforcement applies to a const fn.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is not a generic module hub for evaluation infrastructure or utilities; it is the root of the separate const-safety checking pass, centered on `ConstCx` and queries about const context, const-fn stability, and allowed unstable features before interpretation happens.
